customer_id, requested_slots, dr_region

declared DR event
Operator error protection

EXECUTE TIER 1
PATCH DR CRG quantity
+= requested_slots
No approval needed
RTO: ARM propagation only
(minutes)

quota_neutral: true
Slots_transferred, RTO_duration

display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
status: PENDING_APPROVAL
Alert: Tier2ApprovalRequired
Approver: ACRME.CapacityAdmin
Timeout: 15 min

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EXECUTE TIER 2
1. PATCH NonProd CRG qty → 0
(VMs keep running — no downtime)
2. PATCH DR CRG qty += freed_slots
3. Update QuotaGroup entity
(quota-neutral — same group pool)
RTO: approval + ARM + POC-32 latency

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
REJECTED
No ARM ops executed
Alert closed

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Operator provides vm_disassociation_list
(NonProd VMs only — Prod VMs INELIGIBLE)
Engine validates list preconditions

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
✅ COMPLETED
quota_neutral: true
(same NonProdDR group pool)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Dual approval obtained?
ACRME.EmergencyOperator × 2
(OR break_glass SuperAdmin)

color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EXECUTE TIER 3
VM Disassociation Sequence
Dev → Test → Staging order
Smallest vCPU first
(See Diagram 6)
